title: Feature: draft/published filter buttons in dashboard
body:
Add All/Draft/Published filter buttons to dashboard alongside search and sort.

Implementation:
- Add StatusFilter enum (All, Draft, Published) and status_filter: use_state(StatusFilter::All) to dashboard
- Extend display_entries filtering block (approx line 970) to skip .md files whose PostStatus doesn't match
- Add filter button group (All / Draft / Published) to .filter-sort-bar (approx line 1113)
- Add CSS for .status-filter-bar, .status-btn, .status-btn.active in styles/main.css
- Reset status_filter to All on directory navigation
- Verify: Draft shows only 🌱 files; Published shows only 📰 files; All restores full list
